title: gilia tenuiflora var. grinnellii
intro: Gilia tenuiflora var. grinnellii, commonly known as Grinnell's gilia, is a variety of plant in the phlox family, native to the southwestern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Grinnell's gilia include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
